# runpod_serverless_billing (Data Source)

Serverless spend, time-bucketed. Without serverless_id the API emits one record per endpoint per bucket. Replaces the 1.x provider's billing data source, which read the REST v1 API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_serverless_billing" "all_endpoints" {
  bucket_size = "month"
  last_n      = 3
}

output "serverless_spend_by_endpoint" {
  description = "Spend per endpoint per bucket, in USD."
  value = {
    for r in data.runpod_serverless_billing.all_endpoints.records :
    "${r.serverless_id}/${r.start_time}" => r.amounts.total_amount
  }
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
use-case modules under `v2/modules/` in the provider repository; the Guides
section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bucket_size` (String) Length of each time bucket: "hour", "day" (the API default), "week", "month", or "year".
- `end_time` (String) End of the billing period as an RFC 3339 timestamp, exclusive. Defaults to now. Snapped up to the end of the bucket it lands in unless it is already on a boundary.
- `last_n` (Number) Return the last N buckets, ending with the current in-progress one: last_n 100 with bucket_size "day" is the last 100 days. Names the window on its own: setting it together with start_time or end_time is rejected.
- `serverless_id` (String) Restrict the records to one Serverless endpoint.
- `start_time` (String) Start of the billing period as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Defaults to 30 days ago. Snapped down to the start of its bucket, so a boundary-aligned value (midnight for bucket_size "day") keeps the window from widening.

### Read-Only

- `metadata` (Attributes) The window the API resolved the request to, and the totals over it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `records` (Attributes List) One record per Serverless endpoint per time bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Read-Only:

- `query` (Attributes) Resolved query window, granularity, and filter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata--query))
- `record_count` (Number) Number of records returned: buckets times distinct endpoints.
- `totals` (Attributes) Spend summed over every returned record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata--totals))
- `unique_serverless_count` (Number) Number of distinct Serverless endpoints the records span.

<a id="nestedatt--metadata--query"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata.query`

Read-Only:

- `bucket_size` (String) Bucket length the records are grouped by.
- `end_time` (String) End of the resolved window, exclusive, in RFC 3339 format.
- `serverless_id` (String) The serverless_id filter the API applied; null when unfiltered.
- `start_time` (String) Start of the resolved window, inclusive, in RFC 3339 format.


<a id="nestedatt--metadata--totals"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata.totals`

Read-Only:

- `cpu_amount` (Number) Serverless CPU compute cost in USD.
- `disk_amount` (Number) Serverless disk cost in USD.
- `gpu_amount` (Number) Serverless GPU compute cost in USD.
- `total_amount` (Number) Total serverless cost in USD.



<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `amounts` (Attributes) Cost components of the bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records--amounts))
- `end_time` (String) End of the bucket, exclusive, in RFC 3339 format.
- `serverless_id` (String) The Serverless endpoint this record bills.
- `start_time` (String) Start of the bucket, inclusive, in RFC 3339 format.

<a id="nestedatt--records--amounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records.amounts`

Read-Only:

- `cpu_amount` (Number) Serverless CPU compute cost in USD.
- `disk_amount` (Number) Serverless disk cost in USD.
- `gpu_amount` (Number) Serverless GPU compute cost in USD.
- `total_amount` (Number) Total serverless cost in USD.
